template.title: Sync the newsletter list from the CRM and report the differences
template.author: claude-opus-5-5 (frontier author; hand-written 2026-10-21 for research/surface-20261021 BUILDER-1)
template.whenToUse: Someone wants their mailing or newsletter list kept in step with their CRM or customer sheet: add the contacts that are missing, or only find out who is missing without changing anything, and get a report of what differs.
template.notFor: Sending the newsletter itself, deleting or editing contacts, syncing orders, invoices or payments, or two-way sync.
sources: experiments/library/cards/catalog.json P02 fetch -> transform -> write (sync / ETL)

slots.name: onlyTag
slots.description: Only consider CRM contacts whose tags contain this word, e.g. customer; empty for all contacts.

slots.name: addMissing
slots.description: Add the missing contacts to the newsletter list; false: only report them.

slots.name: reportTo
slots.question: Who should get the sync report? (one e-mail address)
slots.askWhy: The report lists your contacts; I will not guess where it goes.
slots.description: E-mail address that gets the report of what was added and what differs.

data.crm: one row per contact: email, name, company, tags (text, e.g. 'customer; vip'), unsubscribed (true | false)
data.newsletter: the mailing list: email, name, source, addedAt; the flow appends missing contacts

willDo: Read the CRM and the newsletter list

willDo.text: Add the contacts missing from the newsletter list
Only report the contacts missing from the newsletter list; add nothing

willDo: E-mail [[reportTo]] a report of what was missing and which names differ, after you approve the send
Check that no unsubscribed contact was added, and re-read the list and the outbox
willNotDo: Delete or change anyone already on the newsletter list
Send the newsletter or e-mail any contact
Run by itself: you (or your coding agent) start each run

workflow.title: Newsletter list sync
workflow.goal: Each run, compare the newsletter list with the CRM ([[scopeText]]) by e-mail, [[verbText]] the missing subscribed contacts, and e-mail [[reportTo]] a report of the differences after a person approves the send.

assumptions: The crm sheet holds one row per contact with email, name, company, tags and unsubscribed; the newsletter sheet holds email, name, source and addedAt
Delivery is a local outbox file standing in for e-mail; nothing leaves this machine
successCriteria: Exactly the missing contacts were added (or none, in report-only mode)
The report reached the one address you named (checked by re-reading the outbox)
unsupported: Running on a schedule by itself

nodes.description: Keep subscribed contacts with an e-mail address ([[scopeText]])
Compare the CRM with the list by e-mail
Prepare the list rows for the missing contacts
Cross-check: unsubscribed contacts among the rows to add (must be none)
Add the missing contacts to the newsletter list

args.line: - {{key}}: "{{left}}" in the CRM, "{{right}}" on the list

nodes.description: E-mail the report to [[reportTo]] (asks you first)
Re-read the outbox: only the report went out, intact
Re-read the newsletter list: exactly the missing contacts were added (none in report-only mode)
